product: Databricks AI Runtime SDK replaces serverless_gpu
tagline: Starting in GPU environment version 6, the Databricks AI Runtime SDK (databricks sdk air) replaces the deprecated serverless gpu package.
what_it_does: Starting in GPU environment version 6, the Databricks AI Runtime SDK (databricks sdk air) replaces the deprecated serverless gpu package. It provides the @distributed and ray init APIs and the databricks.air.data utilities under the databricks.air namespace. The gpus and gpu type arguments are renamed to num accelerators and accelerator type.
why_it_matters: The same code scales from single GPU to multi GPU with no cluster to provision and no distributed launcher to configure.
